notes: Real-paper gold case from STUDY-c47dd2ce9a62, DOI 10.3389/fmicb.2020.02023, PMCID PMC7469538 (Naples shallow-water hydrothermal vent study). source_text is a verbatim, unedited excerpt of the real stored Europe PMC full text. Re-curated after the original codex-authored version fabricated a sentence ("The extraction used a spin column.") and fact (dna_separation_method = "spin column") that do not appear anywhere in the real paper -- the real text only names the Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue kit, never a separation method. Also recovers several real, explicit facts the original dropped (thermocycler, pcr_reaction_volume, template_dna_volume, sequencing_location).
source_text: Bioinformatics Data Processing Prokaryotic 16S rRNA paired-end reads were merged using USEARCH ( Edgar and Flyvbjerg, 2015 ) after q25 trimming of the ends. The resulting 16S reads were processed using the Find Rapidly OTU with the Galaxy Solution (FROGS) v2 pipeline ( Escudié et al., 2018 ). In short, sequences were depleted of barcode, then sequences < 380 bp and those containing an ambiguous base were removed. Next, reads were clustered into de novo operational taxonomic units (OTUs) using Swarm ( Mahé et al., 2014 ), with an aggregation distance equal to 3. Chimera were then removed with VSEARCH ( Rognes et al., 2016 ). Additionally, a filter (for abundance) was applied to the OTUs, with an optimal threshold of 0.005% ( Bokulich et al., 2013 ). The OTUs finally selected were taxonomically assigned by BLASTn + ( Camacho et al., 2009 ) using the Silva release 132 reference database ( Quast et al., 2013 ). Finally, filtrations were performed on BLAST taxonomic affiliation, with a minimum coverage of 60% and a minimum identity of 60%.
